name: Google Maps
description: Ports agentic-workspace's aw-google-maps MCP into aw-workspace: place search with ratings, reviews, price level and opening hours (the Yelp-shaped question — 'a good sushi place near here, open now'), plus full place details, address geocoding and live-traffic route ETAs. Google Maps Platform via a plain API key — no OAuth, no consent screen, nothing that expires.

skills.description: Place search, place details, geocoding and route ETAs through this app's aw-google-maps MCP server — which tool answers which question, the two-step search→details flow, and the three Google APIs the key must have enabled.

google_maps_api_key.description: Google Maps Platform API key. Routed to the zero-knowledge secret store via POST /api/apps/google-maps/settings — never stored in plain config, unlike the monolith which kept it inline in src/config/mcp.json. The key needs three APIs enabled on its project: Places API (New), Geocoding API and Routes API.

apps.reason: This app contributes an mcp.json entry (the 'aw-google-maps' server) that MCP Gateway discovers and merges; without the gateway no agent can reach its tools.

dependencies.note: Runtime-enforced app dependency: aw-workspace loads mcp-gateway before this app so the gateway can scan google-maps/mcp.json.
